top_stories.title: JumpCloud extends Agentic IAM with new controls for autonomous AI agents
top_stories.summary: JumpCloud has extended its Agentic IAM service with new controls that give IT teams direct management over autonomous AI agents within their organizations. The update places AI agents within the same identity and access management framework used for human users and traditional workloads.

top_stories.title: Identity-Based AI Attack Threatens Security of Enterprise Data
top_stories.summary: A new attack technique called "workflow identity hijacking" has been identified that can bypass standard security controls by exploiting unauthenticated entry points in enterprise environments. The attack targets identity-based weaknesses in AI workflows to gain unauthorized access to organizational data.

top_stories.title: Webinar: How malicious OAuth apps can lead to Google Workspace breaches
top_stories.summary: A webinar examines how attackers use malicious OAuth applications combined with social engineering to breach Google Workspace environments without requiring stolen passwords. The session covers two specific attack scenarios and the security controls that can mitigate OAuth-based authorization abuse.

top_stories.title: Malicious Twitch Browser Extension Leaks OAuth Tokens From Nearly 31,000 Users
top_stories.summary: A malicious browser extension called "Twitch Enhanced Viewer | JeetBot" exfiltrated OAuth tokens from nearly 31,000 Twitch users to Russian commercial bot service proxy servers. The attack demonstrates a cross-store extension threat vector targeting OAuth tokens, which are authentication credentials used to maintain user sessions and authorize access.

top_stories.title: Attackers Use Passkey Phishing to Hijack Microsoft Cloud Accounts and Exfiltrate Data
top_stories.summary: Microsoft disclosed details of two threat actor campaigns targeting cloud accounts, one involving over one million scam emails sent between August 3-5, 2026, and another using passkey-themed social engineering to breach cloud environments. The attacks abuse third-party email delivery infrastructure and involve phishing techniques specifically targeting passkey authentication to hijack Microsoft cloud accounts and exfiltrate data.

news.title: Traefik Labs brings independent verification to AI agent governance
news.summary: Traefik Labs has introduced the Sovereign Trust Plane (STP) in Traefik Hub, a set of capabilities targeting AI agent governance through delegated access, policy enforcement, and verified audit records of gateway decisions across model, tool, and API traffic. General availability is planned by September 30, 2026, with the product addressing authorization and accountability for AI agents performing actions such as accessing customer data and modifying business records.

news.title: Entrust turns cryptographic inventory data into security action
news.summary: Entrust has launched new capabilities for its Cryptographic Security Platform (CSP) enabling organizations to operationalize Cryptographic Bill of Materials (CBOM) data. The update addresses machine and AI identity growth, certificate lifecycle management, post-quantum cryptography transition, and compliance requirements for critical infrastructure sectors.

news.title: 3BB Attacker Used MeshCentral Backdoor for Root Access, Targeted Subscriber Credentials
news.summary: An attacker compromised 3BB, a major Thai broadband provider, using MeshCentral as a backdoor to maintain remote access and target subscriber credentials. The intrusion was discovered by threat intelligence firm Hunt.io after the attacker left a server with tools and data exposed on the internet.

news.title: Bastillion v5.2.1
news.summary: Bastillion released version 5.2.1 of its browser-based SSH access management platform. The tool functions as a bastion host with a dashboard interface for managing SSH access across systems.

news.title: Okta Nearly Doubled This Year. So Why Is SailPoint Still Below Its IPO Price?
news.summary: The article compares the stock performance of Okta and SailPoint, noting Okta nearly doubled in value while SailPoint remains below its IPO price despite a fourth consecutive EPS beat in Q2 FY27. The piece focuses on financial/investor analysis of two major IAM vendors rather than product or technology developments.

news.title: Okta Targets AI Agent Confusion With Identity Security Push
news.summary: Okta is positioning its identity security platform as a solution for managing AI agent access, focusing on where agents operate, which systems they can access, and what actions they are authorized to perform. The move reflects a strategic push by Okta to address emerging challenges around AI agent identity, authorization, and access control.

news.title: Agentic Fabric and AI Could Drive SailPoint’s (SAIL) Next Growth Phase
news.summary: SailPoint reported 25% annual recurring revenue growth in its fiscal Q2 2027, released on September 9. The company is positioning its Agentic Fabric and AI capabilities as key drivers for its next growth phase in the enterprise identity security market.

news.title: Univention Corporate Server: Who Does the Cloud Trust When You Log In?
news.summary: Approximately 5,000 Dropbox accounts were compromised through improperly verified Lenovo IDs, illustrating a federated identity trust failure in cloud authentication. The incident centers on how cloud services establish and verify identity trust relationships, a core concern in SSO and federated authentication architectures.

news.title: AI is changing what Salesforce security needs to govern
news.summary: WithSecure released a paper titled "Navigating Trust in the Modern Salesforce Ecosystem" examining how AI is changing security governance requirements in Salesforce environments. The paper argues that existing governance practices focused on identities, permissions, and access controls are insufficient and that organizations must expand their approach to address AI-specific risks.

news.title: authentik version/2026.8.2
news.summary: authentik has released version 2026.8.2 of its open-source identity provider platform. The release supports SAML, OAuth2/OIDC, LDAP, and RADIUS protocols for centralized authentication, authorization, and access management.

news.title: EU Cyber Resilience Act to Enforce New Reporting Requirements
news.summary: The EU Cyber Resilience Act begins enforcing a 24-hour mandatory reporting requirement for serious product security incidents affecting European organizations. This regulation introduces new compliance obligations relevant to IAM vendors and practitioners operating in the EU market.

news.title: CISA Flags Exploited Cisco, Citrix, Fortinet Flaws, Sets Sept. 12 Federal Patch Deadline
news.summary: CISA added three critical vulnerabilities affecting Cisco, Citrix, and Fortinet to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, with a September 12, 2026 patch deadline for Federal Civilian Executive Branch agencies. One of the flaws, CVE-2026-20079, carries a CVSS score of 10.0 and involves an authentication vulnerability.

news.title: There's a New Black Market Just for Stolen ChatGPT and Claude Logins. It's Open 24/7.
news.summary: Okta published a report revealing that stolen AI account credentials for services like Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Cursor are being traded on Telegram-based black markets. These markets operate with 24/7 customer support, money-back guarantees, and bulk discounts on stolen session tokens.

news.title: TATS
news.summary: A tool called TATS has been released for analyzing and tracking OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and Microsoft Entra ID tokens captured from Burp Suite, mitmproxy, or Chrome DevTools. It provides an interactive dashboard to visualize token lifecycles, detect risky scopes, and export tokens for replay testing.

news.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 1,000 Security Holes
news.summary: Microsoft released a record-breaking patch batch addressing at least 974 security vulnerabilities across Windows and other software. AI is being credited with accelerating vulnerability discovery, though security experts note organizations are struggling to keep up with testing and deploying the volume of fixes.

news.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
news.summary: A dark web service is selling digital scans of over 153 million drivers licenses from the US and Canada, apparently sourced from a Louisiana-based identity verification company. The FBI's New Orleans field office has opened an official inquiry into the breach.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian cybercriminal Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges for hacking and extorting over 165 organizations that used Snowflake's cloud data storage platform. The case involved credential-based attacks exploiting stolen login information to access Snowflake customer accounts, affecting over 100 million AT&T customers' records.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA released a postmortem report on a data breach where a contractor publicly exposed dozens of internal CISA credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, on GitHub for nearly six months. The incident highlights credential management and secrets governance failures, with the exposure going undetected until KrebsOnSecurity notified the agency.
